title: Meters and energy
description: Utility meters of properties and units, readings, consumption and period costs. Consumption is only computed from two consecutive readings of the same meter in the same unit.

fieldHelp.serialNumber: Number on the meter label; must be unique.
fieldHelp.unit: E.g. kWh, m³ or GJ. Changing the unit starts a new comparable series of readings.
fieldHelp.supplyPoint: EAN, EIC or your own supply point label.
fieldHelp.consumer: Who the medium is re-invoiced to, e.g. the unit tenant.

filters.search: Search meter, supply point or unit
filters.noMatchDescription: Change the search or pick another medium.

stats.readings30Hint: Valid readings dated within the last 30 days
stats.anomaliesHint: Last period more than 30 % above the previous one
stats.costHint: Sum of recorded costs of periods ending in this month

edit.title: Edit meter {{serial}}
edit.retire: The meter is retired (no new readings)

reading.title: Record reading
reading.valueHelp: Total value on the meter display, not the consumption.
reading.costHelp: Optional. Amount for the period ending with this reading; empty shows as “no data”.
reading.photoRestricted: Reading photos are available to internal roles only. You can save the reading without a photo.
reading.photoHelp: Optional, JPG or PNG up to 5 MB. Stored in Siampark documents.
reading.photoTooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
reading.photoFailed: The photo could not be uploaded; the reading was not saved.
reading.previewFirst: This will be the meter's first reading: consumption shows from the next reading on.
reading.previewAnomaly: Note: daily consumption is {{change}} above the previous period.
reading.invalidCost: The cost must be a non-negative amount.

problems.future: The reading date cannot be in the future.
problems.duplicateDate: The meter already has a valid reading on this date. Void the wrong reading first.
problems.lowerThanPrevious: The value is lower than the previous reading. For a meter exchange, create a new meter.
problems.higherThanNext: The value is higher than the next reading of this meter.
problems.retired: The meter is retired; no reading can be recorded.

void.title: Void the reading of {{date}}
void.reasonHelp: The reading stays in the history but no longer counts.

detail.historyHint: A difference is only shown between two consecutive valid readings in the same unit.
detail.chartEmpty: The chart appears after two valid readings.
detail.chartAria: Bar chart of the consumption of meter {{serial}} per period
detail.author: Recorded by {{who}} {{at}}

byUnit.title: Consumption and costs by location
byUnit.description: Monthly consumption of the meters of the selected property or unit. Media and units of measure are never added together.
byUnit.chartAria: Bar chart of monthly consumption: {{medium}} in {{unit}}, {{place}}
byUnit.empty: This location and medium has no two consecutive readings yet.
